# New dependency notices for remediation

- yauzl: MIT, copyright Josh Wolfe. Full notice in YAUZL-LICENSE.txt. Source: https://github.com/thejoshwolfe/yauzl . Used server-side for bounded ZIP traversal; archive entries independently hashed against the manifest.
- Symphonia 0.5.5: MPL-2.0, unmodified pure Rust MP3 decoder dependencies (symphonia, symphonia-core, symphonia-metadata, symphonia-bundle-mp3). Source: https://github.com/pdeljanov/Symphonia/tree/v0.5.5 ; license: https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/ . Full license in SYMPHONIA-MPL-2.0.txt. Optional dependency enabled only by the customization feature; no third-party executable or audio assets bundled. Preserve upstream copyright notices and make corresponding MPL source available when distributing binaries. No distribution is performed in this mission.

Existing dependency notices and licenses remain applicable. This is not a complete SBOM or a legal clearance certificate.
